# Sail.Money

> Sail is a protocol for onchain separately managed accounts (SMAs): capital stays in a self-custodial Safe, and a manager — typically an autonomous agent — executes only what on-chain permission contracts allow, enforced by the SailKernel on every dispatch. The docs split into two sections: Protocol (the on-chain trusted core) and Sailor (the off-chain TypeScript operator toolkit + CLI, designed to be operated through coding agents).

## Protocol

- [Overview](/protocol/protocol): What an onchain SMA is, the dispatch model, and the trusted-core components.
- [Concepts: SMAs](/protocol/concepts/smas): What a separately managed account is and why it exists.
- [Concepts: The three roles](/protocol/concepts/roles): Owner, Permission Signer, Manager — who holds what authority.
- [Concepts: The mandate & selective dispatch](/protocol/concepts/mandate): The mandate is a set of permission contracts; each dispatch names one.
- [Concepts: The four evaluation guarantees](/protocol/concepts/evaluation-guarantees): staticcall, gas cap (150k), selective authorization, fail-closed.
- [Concepts: Deterministic deployment](/protocol/concepts/deterministic-deployment): Same core + SMA address on every chain (CREATE2, boundSalt).
- [Concepts: Glossary](/protocol/concepts/glossary): Precise definitions of every term.
- [Architecture](/protocol/architecture): Trusted core vs periphery; component map.
- [Architecture: SailKernel](/protocol/architecture/kernel): Registry, dispatch, fees, nonces, constants.
- [Architecture: SailGovernance & Timelock](/protocol/architecture/governance): Caps, 48h timelock, pause, allowlists.
- [Architecture: MandateFactory](/protocol/architecture/mandate-factory): Bundles configure→register; holds no privilege.
- [Architecture: SafeModuleEnabler](/protocol/architecture/safe-module-enabler): Enables the kernel as a Safe module at setup.
- [Architecture: Single & batch dispatch](/protocol/architecture/dispatch): dispatch / dispatchBatch; approve→call→reset.
- [Permission system](/protocol/permissions): How to build on top — the heart of the protocol.
- [Permissions: IPermission & Context](/protocol/permissions/ipermission): The interface every permission implements.
- [Permissions: Full expressiveness](/protocol/permissions/expressiveness): Arbitrary Solidity, not a constraint grammar.
- [Permissions: Shared multi-tenant templates](/protocol/permissions/shared-templates): Example implementations of the pattern (verify and test before production).
- [Permissions: Lifecycle](/protocol/permissions/lifecycle): Register, configure, replace, revoke, rotate.
- [Permissions: Extension interfaces](/protocol/permissions/extensions): Introspection and agent-identity conventions (tooling-only).
- [Guides: Write your first permission](/protocol/guides/write-a-permission): A minimal IPermission, line by line.
- [Guides: Deploy an SMA](/protocol/guides/deploy-an-sma): Safe creation, kernel module, deterministic address.
- [Guides: Register a mandate](/protocol/guides/register-a-mandate): Sign and submit permission registration.
- [Guides: Dispatch within bounds](/protocol/guides/dispatch): Execute a call; what a revert looks like.
- [Guides: Use a shared template](/protocol/guides/use-a-template): Configure SharedBoundedSwapPermission end to end.
- [Fees & governance](/protocol/fees-and-governance): Two fee mechanisms, immutable caps, governance.
- [Security: Guarantees](/protocol/security/guarantees): The six bytecode-level guarantees.
- [Security: Limitations](/protocol/security/limitations): Permission correctness, manager-attested NAV, off-chain components.
- [Security: Audits](/protocol/security/audits): Octane Security audit status; security@sail.money.
- [Reference: Deployment addresses](/protocol/reference/addresses): Trusted core, identical on six chains.
- [Reference: EIP-712 typed data](/protocol/reference/eip712): Every type string the kernel verifies.
- [Reference: Contract reference](/protocol/reference/contracts): Per-contract function surface.

## Sailor

- [Overview](/sailor/sailor): The off-chain operator toolkit; relation to the Protocol.
- [Getting started: Quickstart](/sailor/getting-started/quickstart): Install, then zero to a dispatched transaction.
- [Getting started: Operate Sailor with a coding agent](/sailor/getting-started/coding-agent): The flagship workflow — scaffold, open in your assistant, say "start".

- [Concepts: On-chain vs off-chain](/sailor/concepts/on-chain-off-chain): Financial bounds on-chain; cadence off-chain.
- [Concepts: Keys & custody](/sailor/concepts/keys-and-custody): Owner browser-only; manager key encrypted.
- [Guides: Deploy & predict an SMA](/sailor/guides/deploy-sma)

- [Troubleshooting & FAQ](/sailor/troubleshooting): Common errors and what they mean.
